items.t: Truist Securities Maintains Buy on Digital Realty Trust, Lowers Price Target to $215
items.sum: Truist Securities analyst Matthew Niknam maintains Digital Realty Trust (NYSE:DLR) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $220 to $215.

items.t: DLR Boosts Frankfurt Data Center Capacity With New Power Connection
items.sum: Digital Realty adds a dedicated 110-kV power connection delivering up to 300 MVA to support Frankfurt campus expansion and evolving customer needs.

items.t: Why Equinix and Digital Realty Benefit From Data Center Zoning Battles
items.sum: New data center zoning restrictions and rising construction costs are boosting pricing power for established operators Equinix and Digital Realty, which posted record third-quarter bookings.
